A '''polarizer''' was a component of a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]],<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> connected by a spar piece known as a [[Conducting Rod]].<ref name="EGWT" /> Each bowcaster had two polarizers, and an alternating polarity pulse was passed between them. This allowed the the weapon to accelerate the metal bowstring forward at tremendous speed, launching an explosive [[Quarrel/Legends|quarrel]].<ref name="SWTSE" />
